zh: 巴黎萨克雷大学（Université Paris-Saclay）成立于2019年，位于法国伊夫林省吉夫-叙尔-伊夫特市，是法国顶尖的公立研究型大学。学校在自然科学、工程、医学、社会科学等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居法国前列。巴黎萨克雷大学以其优秀的教学质量和丰富的学术资源，培养了大量各领域的杰出人才。
en: Université Paris-Saclay, founded in 2019, is a leading public research university in Gif-sur-Yvette, Yvelines, France. It excels in natural sciences, engineering, medicine, social sciences, and more, with leading academic research in France. Known for its excellent teaching quality and rich academic resources, Université Paris-Saclay has produced numerous talents across fields.
